ev.q: Mortality attributable to HIV infection and acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS) increased rapidly for both men and women
From 1999 to 2003, men experienced a modest but steady decrease in HIV/AIDS mortality; the death rate for women was unchanged.
Mortality attributable to HIV infection and acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS) increased rapidly for both men and women
the death rate for women was unchanged.
The rate then decreased sharply until 1997 before leveling off.
SOURCE: National Vital Statistics System, National Center for Health Statistics, CDC.
